arguments.summary: A credential compromise was detected for user j.martinez, originating from external IP 91.219.236.174. UEBA analysis showed low-risk anomalies, but SIEM and EDR confirmed suspicious network activity. The compromised host (WS-IT-101, 10.0.2.15) had been scanned externally and used for internal authentication. Immediate actions included credential revocation for the user and a full endpoint scan, which found no malware. No lateral movement was confirmed, but access patterns indicated potential reconnaissance.

rule Suspicious_Webshell_File {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common webshell file patterns in web root directories"
        author = "SOC Team"
        date = "2026-04-08"
    strings:
        $http_request = /\$_(GET|POST|REQUEST)\[.*\]/ nocase
        $exec_func = /\$(exec|shell_exec|system|passthru)\(/ nocase
        $base64_decode = "base64_decode" nocase
        $eval_func = "eval(" nocase
        $file_path = "/var/www/html/.*\\.php$" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of ($http_request, $exec_func) or ($base64_decode and $eval_func) and $file_path
}
